updates.v011Memory: 32-bit browsers should crash less, and if the game runs out of memory you can keep playing without intercity trips

updates.v02BusLoops: bus and ferry loop lines, one way or both ways
updates.v02Colors: one speed color scale for trains, trams, buses and boats
updates.v02Limit: set a speed limit on a line
updates.v02BusFare: bus fare multiple in the money tab
updates.v02Places: new places: morocco, algeria, tunisia, egypt, israel and palestine
updates.v02Hidden: some new hidden achievements to find
updates.v02ColorBlind: color blind option for the demand bubbles

updates.v02BusManual: bus lines can have their stops placed by hand
updates.v02Purpose: demand bubbles can be colored by trip purpose
updates.v02StopOrder: drag a train line's stops into the order you want
updates.v02Terrain: terrain map updated to cover the whole world
updates.v02Crowding: buses and boats have similar crowding mechanism to trains

updates.v03Share: added community! share networks, browse other peoples maps

updates.v03Quad: high-speed and tram track can be built as quad

updates.v03Curves: lower target speed allowed, tighter track curvature allowed
updates.v03Ferries: ferry routes can run much further
